headline: The Qilin ransomware gang is breaching corporate networks through a critical Palo Alto GlobalProtect flaw as fresh extortion schemes and AI-agent attacks surface across the industry.

emerging_trends.text: The Qilin ransomware gang has begun breaching corporate networks through a critical Palo Alto Networks GlobalProtect authentication bypass, the latest crew to turn a freshly disclosed VPN flaw into an extortion foothold.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Qilin Ransomware Exploits Palo Alto GlobalProtect VPN

emerging_trends.text: Attackers keep prying open AI agents, and researchers now show that an Android app can feed invisible on-screen text to the agent driving a phone and then run commands on the PC behind it.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Invisible Text Hijacks Android AI Agents

emerging_trends.text: Novel research such as Bit2Watt shows that ordinary cloud GPU access alone can swing a data center's power draw hard enough to threaten the electrical grid, with no exploit and no break-in.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Bit2Watt Turns Cloud GPUs Against the Power Grid

topics.title: Estée Lauder Oracle EBS Breach
topics.latest_developments: Estée Lauder disclosed that attackers exploited an Oracle E-Business Suite zero-day to exfiltrate personal, financial, and health information from its human-resources system back in August 2025.
topics.summary: The cosmetics maker, one of the world's largest beauty companies, ran the vulnerable Oracle EBS instance for HR operations; affected individuals face exposure of Social Security and payment data and should watch for identity fraud.

sources.title: Estée Lauder Discloses Impact From Oracle EBS Zero-Day Hack
Estée Lauder discloses data breach tied to Oracle EBS vulnerability
Estée Lauder discloses data breach via Oracle E-Business flaw

topics.title: BitLocker Extortion via Office Printers
topics.latest_developments: Kaspersky's Securelist detailed two recent cases in which attackers turned Windows' own BitLocker against victims, locking drives after entering through RDP, MSSQL, RMM tools, and web shells, then printing small ransom demands on the targets' office printers.
topics.summary: The scheme weaponizes native BitLocker encryption and low ransom figures to extract quiet payments; Kaspersky published the tactics and defenses as governments weigh outright bans on ransom payments amid a broader surge in attacks.

sources.title: A new extortion cocktail: office printers, small ransoms, and BitLocker
Pay up or not? Ransomware surge has victims facing tough choices.

topics.title: Fresh Patches for Zimbra and Windows LegacyHive
topics.latest_developments: Zimbra shipped an update resolving critical command injection, cross-site scripting, restriction bypass, and SSRF flaws, while 0patch released free unofficial micropatches for the Windows LegacyHive zero-day that escalates privileges on fully updated systems.
topics.summary: Zimbra mail servers and up-to-date Windows machines both remain exposed until administrators apply the fixes; the LegacyHive privilege-escalation bug lacks an official Microsoft patch, making the free micropatch a stopgap for exposed hosts.

sources.title: Zimbra Update Patches Critical Vulnerabilities
Windows LegacyHive zero-day flaw gets free, unofficial patches

topics.title: Qilin Ransomware Exploits Palo Alto GlobalProtect VPN
topics.latest_developments: Arctic Wolf caught the Qilin ransomware gang exploiting a critical PAN-OS GlobalProtect authentication bypass to breach victims' networks, marking the flaw's shift from disclosure to active ransomware use.
topics.summary: Palo Alto Networks' GlobalProtect VPN carries an authentication bypass that lets attackers slip past login controls; Qilin now rides it into corporate networks, so operators running PAN-OS should patch and audit GlobalProtect portals immediately.

sources.title: Critical Palo Alto VPN bug now exploited by Qilin ransomware gang

topics.title: Invisible Text Hijacks Android AI Agents
topics.latest_developments: Researchers demonstrated that an Android app able to draw over other windows and write to shared storage can plant instructions no human eye will see, feed them to the AI agent driving the phone, and in two more steps run commands on the PC controlling that agent.
topics.summary: The chain, one of seven attacks shown against five open-source mobile agent frameworks including AppAgent and AppAgentX, exposes how autonomous phone agents trust on-screen text; developers should treat rendered content as untrusted input and isolate agent execution.

sources.title: Open-Source Android AI Agents Could Let Invisible Screen Text Run Code on Host PCs

topics.title: Bit2Watt Turns Cloud GPUs Against the Power Grid
topics.latest_developments: Three Zhejiang University researchers unveiled Bit2Watt in a paper accepted to CHES 2026, showing that a cloud tenant using nothing but ordinary GPU access can push a data center's power draw up and down fast enough to threaten the electrical grid feeding it.
topics.summary: Bit2Watt needs no exploit and no break-in, relying only on legitimate GPU workloads to modulate power; the finding pressures cloud providers to smooth and monitor data-center power dynamics against grid-destabilizing tenants.

sources.title: New Bit2Watt Attack Could Let Cloud Tenants Disrupt Power Grids Without an Exploit

business_politics.title: US-Iran War Nears Full Scale as Hegseth Seeks $67 Billion
business_politics.latest_developments: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and top commanders went to Capitol Hill on July 21 to ask Congress for $67 billion in war funding as the US launched a 10th consecutive night of strikes on Iran and Tehran struck a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz.
business_politics.summary: The United States and Iran appear to be sliding back toward full-scale war; 17 American troops have died, US forces are bombing Iran nightly to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, and Iran is firing on Gulf shipping, keeping Brent crude near $90 a barrel.

sources.title: The U.S. and Iran appear to be headed back to a full-scale war. Read more in today's WSJ Politics Newsletter:

business_politics.title: Trump Renews Trade War After Supreme Court Voids Reciprocal Tariffs
business_politics.latest_developments: With the Supreme Court having thrown out his reciprocal duties, President Trump prepared a fresh tariff barrage on July 21, threatening an additional 50% on Canadian goods and letting broad 10% levies expire, as US petrol climbed back above $4 a gallon.
business_politics.summary: Trump is reigniting his global trade war, threatening 50% tariffs on a wide range of Canadian goods over autos, alcohol, and dairy after the US Supreme Court struck down the reciprocal duties that anchored his tariff regime.

sources.title: Trump threatens to reignite trade war with fresh 50% tariffs on Canada
